reviews.review_msg: Every class was a talk given by someone. You had to show up to class and ask a question every other class and write a report. You also had to create a linked-in profile and attend an event and give a short 3-minute talk about it. The course was well organized. I guess my only complaint is that he didn't release any grades on any assignments.

Different speaker each week and then a 250 word paragraph about what you learned. The TA doesn't give any feedback so it's hard to know what went wrong. You have to sign an attendance sheet at every class.
